content.value_statement: Brands need to act on trends before they fade, without joining moments that harm trust. This skill turns trend signals into ranked opportunities, timing windows, and go or skip calls.
actual_capabilities: Defines trend parameters for brand, audience, platform, geography, horizon, and content categories.
Ranks current topics, hashtags, sounds, challenges, and formats by relevance and lifecycle.
Scores each trend against audience fit, brand fit, adaptability, risk, and timing.
Builds a cultural calendar with lead times, opportunities, and conversations to avoid.
Creates a trend report with act-now items, watch lists, avoid lists, and next review dates.
Can use public RSS and keyless search sources when the agent has suitable tools.
limitations: It does not replace direct platform analytics or paid social listening data.
Public feed signals can be incomplete, delayed, or noisy.
It does not identify creators for execution; use a creator discovery workflow for that.
Brand safety decisions still need human review for regulated or sensitive categories.

use_cases.title: Plan Campaign Timing
use_cases.description: Compare fast-moving topics and select moments with clear brand fit and near-term timing.

use_cases.title: Screen Trend Participation
use_cases.description: Evaluate a hashtag, challenge, or sound before approving creator briefs.

use_cases.title: Map Cultural Moments
use_cases.description: Build a calendar of events, conversations, and seasonal opportunities for the next quarter.

prompt_templates.title: Find Relevant Trends
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner trend scan for one brand and platform.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find current trends for [brand or industry] on [platform]. Use [audience] and [region]. Rank the best opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate One Trend
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused go or skip decision for a candidate trend.
prompt_templates.prompt: Should [brand] join [trend]? Score brand fit, audience fit, timing, risk, and content adaptability. Give a go, caution, or skip call.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cultural Calendar
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning campaign moments across a month or quarter.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [month or quarter] cultural calendar for [brand]. Include lead times, content angles, risks, and moments to avoid.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multi-Source Signals
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced validation using available public trend signals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use available public trend sources for [vertical]. Compare repeated signals across feeds, classify lifecycle stage, and produce a ranked action plan.

output_examples.input: What TikTok trends should a fitness apparel brand consider this month?
output_examples.output: The report ranks three act-now trends, two watch-list ideas, and one avoid item. Each entry includes fit, timing, risk, and format guidance.

output_examples.input: Should our skincare brand use a viral audio trend?
output_examples.output: The result gives a caution decision because the audience fit is strong but brand safety risk is mixed. It suggests safer creator angles.

output_examples.input: Plan next quarter cultural moments for a gaming hardware launch.
output_examples.output: The calendar lists upcoming events, preparation windows, platform formats, and conversations to avoid before campaign approval.

best_practices: Provide brand values, audience segments, platforms, region, and time horizon before asking for recommendations.
Ask for evidence labels when signals come from public feeds or estimates.
Review skip and caution items before assigning creator briefs.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to chase every viral topic without brand-fit criteria.
Do not treat estimated public-feed data as verified platform analytics.
Do not use the output as final approval for legal, medical, financial, or regulated categories.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a ranked trend report with fit scores, lifecycle calls, cultural moments, and go, caution, or skip recommendations.

faq.question: Does it need paid tools?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user context and optional public sources when tools are available.

faq.question: Can it find influencers?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose trends. Use a creator discovery skill to find people who can execute them.

faq.question: How current are the results?
faq.answer: They depend on the data sources and user context available during the session.

faq.question: Can it use Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code hosts.

faq.question: How should risky trends be handled?
faq.answer: Treat caution and skip calls as review prompts. Check brand safety, legal risk, and community context before posting.
